title: Dessimination of Information: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: Answer question 1 (compulsory) and any other 2 questions. Dissemination of information (2 Marks)

parts.text: State reasons why libraries undertake dissemination of information and its relevance.
State any three reasons why evaluation is relevant to an information manager.
List down five limitations of a general bibliography as a tool of collection development.
Explain the meaning of Reference Services.

What are the advantages of selective dissemination of information (SDI) Process. a) Explain clearly Five types of Bibliographic services offered in a Documentation center and state the relevance of each.
Discuss the role of computers in the selective dissemination of information(SDI) Process.
State the problems involved in the provision of user education.
Highlight Four major types of bibliographic sources.
Discuss four major methods of providing Current awareness Service in an information center.
Discuss the methods used to disseminate information and the role of computers and other information technology in the entire process.
Explain the methods used in the provision of current awareness services.
Explain the importance of reference sources in an information center.
Write short notes on the reference service, reference process, reference work and reference interview.
